breathe.heading: Breathe
breathe.sub: Breathe in for 4. Hold for 4. Breathe out for 6. Follow the circle, or just the words.

checkin.heading: Check in

lines.Angry: Anger usually points at something that matters to you. It can wait until your hands are steady. Breathe first, decide later.
lines.Anxious: A loud mind is hard to carry. You do not have to solve everything in the next ten minutes. One breath is a fine next step.
lines.Calm: Calm is a good place to stand. Stay a while. There is nothing to fix right now.
lines.Hopeful: Hopeful is worth protecting. Write down the thing you hope for, while it is clear. Future you will want the note.
lines.Numb: Feeling nothing is also a feeling. Start small: cold water on your face, a window open, one thing you can see and name.
lines.Okay: Okay counts. Not every day has to be a big day. Okay is a real place to be.
lines.Sad: Sad is heavy, and it is honest. You do not have to carry today all at once. One small kind thing for yourself is enough.
lines.Tired: Tired makes sense. Rest is allowed. Even a short pause is a pause.

checkin.prompt: Pick the word closest to how you feel right now.

crisis.heading: If this is a crisis
crisis.line1Text: The 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline, in the United States. Free, confidential, 24 hours a day. You can also chat at 988lifeline.org.
crisis.line2Text: Crisis Text Line connects you with a live, trained volunteer Crisis Counselor. Free, confidential, 24 hours a day.

footer.line1: Still is part of Aurora Commons. It serves Layer 1 of the Ascent: the mind at peace.
footer.line2: This page works fully offline once loaded. It makes no network calls. Your writing stays in this browser.

grounding.heading: One grounding practice: 5-4-3-2-1
grounding.source: Source: University of Rochester Medical Center, Behavioral Health Partners blog. The steps above are written in our own words.
steps: Name five things you can see.
Name four things you can touch.
Name three things you can hear.
Name two things you can smell.
Name one thing you can taste.
grounding.sub: A way to come back to the room you are in, one sense at a time.
